text:
sam: packaging job pkg-3178 (v1.4.3-airgap) is stuck at signing step — cosign hit a timeout against signer-02.
sam: looks like signer queue is 1/3, retry loop not clearing.

deploy-bot: pkg-3178: cosign: signing attempt failed -> 504 gateway. retrying (attempt 3/5). logs: /var/log/deploy/pkg-3178.log

mira: signer-02 flaked yesterday too, fwiw. probably the same flapping issue we saw in eu-west.

toni: short term: switch to fallback signer-03 for this cutover and re-cosign the sealed manifest. cheap and fast if infra approves. :thumbsup:

alex: switching signers is fine but note: it creates a new cosign key fingerprint. we need to: bump manifest epoch, update installer metadata, and call out the signer swap in release notes. customers using pinned fingerprints will need guidance.

eng-oncall: hold the staging cutover for now. do not flip traffic or export artifacts to airgap buckets until we validate signing chain. escalated to infra (@infra).

sam: I can run the manual sign with signer-03 if infra exposes the key socket. steps I plan:
```
# repush artifact to staging bucket
aws s3 cp build/v1.4.3.tar.gz s3://staging-airgap/pkg-3178/
cosign sign --key cosign://signer-03 pkg-3178/manifest.json
sha256sum v1.4.3.tar.gz > v1.4.3.sha256
```
then run `cosign verify-blob --key cosign://signer-03 manifest.json` and `sha256sum -c v1.4.3.sha256`

mira: if you do manual sign, also re-run the packaging smoke (untar + run ./install --dry-run) — we saw a packaging edge case earlier.

toni: rollback plan if anything fails: revert to sealed-manifests/v1.4.2 (already uploaded) and run `deploybot rollback --manifest sealed-manifests/v1.4.2` then open a postmortem.

alex: also add a short blurb in the release notes: "Temporary signer swap to signer-03 due to signer-02 transient outage; fingerprint X->Y" and timestamp the epoch change. ops/legal might need the audit log.

eng-oncall: confirmed: do NOT run wide release until cosign verify passes on a detached host. If manual sign happens, ping me and I'll run the verification in eu-west.

deploy-bot: CUTOVER STATUS UPDATED: pkg-3178 -> HOLD. Window extended by +45m. Assigned: infra, releases. Next automated retry paused.

sam: starting manual repush + sign now (I have creds for signer-03). will post checksums and cosign verify output here.

mira: thanks — if we get green, let's document the signer failover steps in the runbook so next time it's one-click. :memo:

toni: noted — I'll draft a short runbook snippet and link it to the release checklist.

deploy-bot: reminder: if revert is required, run `deploybot rollback --manifest=sealed-manifests/v1.4.2 --unsafe=false` and notify #customer-ops.

eng-oncall: keeping channel open. infra folk, pls advise on why signer-02 timed out and whether we should quarantine it before next scheduled signing window.

sam: update: manual sign succeeded. cosign verify output: 
```
Verification for manifest.json: OK
Signed by: cosign://signer-03 (fingerprint: sha256:abc123...def)
```
sha256sum verified: OK

mira: green. runbook entry incoming. anything else before we un-hold?

eng-oncall: run a second verify from eu-west and then un-hold. I'll unpause the deploy-bot after confirmation.

deploy-bot: hold released by eng-oncall at 3178123620. scheduled cutover resumed. final note: record signer swap in release metadata (release_meta/signed_by=signer-03).
